mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the past 3 months (3-month change < 0), or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 315.0, it signals persistent inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to immediate market repricing.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 315.0, or the Rank IC over any 1-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of instances where both INDPRO and HOUST have declined over the past 3 months (3-month change < 0 for both), or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market (UNRATE < 4.0 and PAYEMS > 158000.0), sustained corporate earnings growth leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0 and PAYEMS > 158000.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1300.0, it signals a weakening housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST < 1300.0, or the Rank IC over any 1-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPI (CPIAUCSL > 315.0) and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%) signals hawkish monetary policy, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 315.0 and FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
